summary: Frontend-only testing of Favorites feature on the PHP-served AvrupaPazari site. All 10 test scenarios passed: logged-out heart on / opens #authModal without navigation; login via modal works; logged-in heart on home toggles .active + aria-pressed=true without navigation; server-rendered active state persists after reload; /account.php shows data-testid='account-favorites' with data-testid='favorite-card-<id>'; header data-testid='user-menu-toggle' menu contains data-testid='menu-favorites' -> href=/account.php#favorites; unfavoriting from account card removes it from DOM (no navigation) and after reload shows data-testid='favorites-empty'; listing detail /pages/listing.php?slug=mercedes-c180-2019 #favBtn toggles .active and #favText between 'Favorilere Ekle' <-> 'Kaydedildi'; logged-out click on #favBtn opens auth modal (no navigation); regression /pages/jobs.php and /pages/category.php?module=jobs both 200 with no PHP errors. No JS console errors (only expected 401 from toggle-favorite.php when logged out, which triggers modal). Test user left with 0 favorites.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily favorited listing id=33 (Mercedes) on home; unfavorited during test flow. Final state: 0 favorites for test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Favorites feature fully working across home/, account.php, listing.php, jobs.php, category.php?module=jobs. Uses /ajax/toggle-favorite.php (POST listing_id, returns {status: added|removed|login_required, count}). Selectors: [data-fav], data-testid='fav-btn-<id>', data-testid='favorite-card-<id>', data-testid='account-favorites', data-testid='favorites-empty', data-testid='menu-favorites', #favBtn / #favText on listing detail. Auth flow: [data-testid=join-button] -> auth-tab-login -> login-email/login-password/login-submit -> redirect /account.php.
